question: Which three miner addresses occur most often among execution blocks in the pinned inclusive window on chain 1?

definitions.window: Use the exact quoted fromBlock through toBlock, both inclusive. Do not substitute a moving latest block.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.source: Use JSON-RPC at https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com for chain 1; verify eth_chainId. Chain evidence here is read by panel members, not a deployer recipe.
definitions.metric: Fetch every block with eth_getBlockByNumber(number,false); count one observation per miner field per block, including the zero address.
definitions.ordering: Descending block count; ties by ascending numeric address. Return up to 3 unique addresses.
